commit_message: Connect ADR 0110 Humanoid model import metadata
pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 in staged dispatcher requests. This stage exposes the Humanoid profile/motion/import modules through the engine facade and connects model import results to the editor pipeline so valid model-owned Humanoid profiles and stable portable HumanoidMotion sub-assets are published alongside Native assets. Motion-only, failed, cancelled, and disconnected imports explicitly carry no model-owned profiles.
